doc: Lane gunplay (night 2026-11-04): how each bullet gun of weapons.json reads in the real fight (GunFx + GunFxArt, drawn by FxView). Metres and seconds; claw_side_m = how far right of Rivet's centre line his rig holds the gun (the flash, smoke and shells leave there; measured on the 64 px/m range clip); the view steps it on the stage tick, never on frame delta, and it never touches the sim. casing_m = the ejected shell's length (0 = none); casing_s = how long a shell lies before it fades. muzzle_m = the forward flare; muzzle_side_m = the side jets; spikes = 3 for a forward flare with two side jets (a heavy single shot), 4+ for a star that turns 45 degrees every shot (an automatic's strobe); muzzle_ticks = how long the flash holds. smoke = the gun smoke puff's scale after a shot (an automatic's small puffs pile into a haze). tracer_px / tracer_core_px = the ink casing and the cream core of the tracer (its length is weapons.json tracer_len_m). mag_drop = an empty magazine falls from the claw when a reload starts. default = every other table gun (rocket, flame, electro, molotov draw their own projectile in FightAreasArt): no shells, no magazine, no star flash, only the smoke puff. Shell colour: casing (a muted brass; red is blood only).
